context_requirements: Functional TRPV1, TRPV4, TRPA1, or TRPM8 channels (or CFTR/CNR1/GPR119 for non-TRPV targets)
Intact calcium signaling and downstream MAPK/NFAT/NF-kB pathways
Presence of endogenous agonists or sensitizing stimuli (e.g., low pH, temperature, lipids) for full activation
Cell lines with low basal stress and proliferation to reveal specific transcriptional changes
falsifiers: No induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in any line
No dose-dependent or target-dependent transcriptional signature across lines
Lack of correlation between TRPV target expression and response magnitude
Predominant cholesterol synthesis or interferon signatures instead of stress/proliferation changes
